# Wrenchli Developers

> Developer documentation for the Wrenchli Assessment API: a key-gated API that takes a vehicle's year, make, and model plus the symptoms its owner describes, and returns a preliminary symptom assessment with likely causes, an urgency level, and a fair cost range.

This is the developer door of Wrenchli (Wrenchli, Inc., Detroit, Michigan). The consumer product lives at https://www.wrenchli.net; this door carries the API documentation, the custom GPT guide, API key management and billing, and the canonical OpenAPI document.

## Documentation

- [API documentation](https://developers.wrenchli.net/): Integrate Wrenchli's vehicle symptom assessment into your app. Code examples in Python, JavaScript, and curl. API keys are issued and managed on this page (sign-in required).
- [Custom GPT guide](https://developers.wrenchli.net/gpt-actions): Build a custom GPT on the Wrenchli Assessment API using the OpenAPI document as its action schema.
- [OpenAPI document](https://developers.wrenchli.net/openapi.json): The canonical machine-readable description of the Wrenchli Assessment API (partner access, key-gated).

## Endpoints

- API base: https://aunrktvltmyrxtdygykt.supabase.co/functions/v1 — POST /api-assess (preferred) or /api-diagnose (original name, identical). Every call is authenticated with an API key (x-api-key header) and rate limited per key.
- [MCP server](https://www.wrenchli.net/mcp): Wrenchli's Model Context Protocol endpoint (server name "wrenchli", version 1.1.0), served from the main site. It offers three tools: assess_vehicle_symptoms, check_repair_price, and lookup_trouble_code. All are free; a free API key identifies the calling agent (request one instantly at https://www.wrenchli.net/mcp-keys). Prices served are only the ranges that pass Wrenchli's credibility grading (SOUND-graded price book entries).
- [Agent card](https://www.wrenchli.net/.well-known/agent-card.json): Wrenchli's agent card describing the service, its operator, and its assessment skill.

## Notes

- The assessment is a preliminary symptom assessment, not a professional inspection or a repair quote. Cost ranges are Wrenchli editorial planning estimates; where an assessment maps to a repair in Wrenchli's shared rate table, the response carries a rate_source field saying so.
- Wrenchli never sells consumer data. The consumer privacy policy is at https://www.wrenchli.net/privacy and the subprocessor list at https://www.wrenchli.net/subprocessors.
